snippet.title: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class | First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
This game is coming soon to Steam Early Access! 
Gameplay was captured on a PC powered by NVIDIA RTX 4070 super. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109160/Teaching_Simulator_Elite_Class/?curator_clanid=4777282

Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.
